rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something physically shut, especially a door, window, or lid.
This is the all-purpose choice for physically closing something or stopping a device, service, app, or file.

example.english: I need to shut the window now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 gwaan1 go3 coeng1

rows.note: Use this when a shop, business, museum, or other venue closes for the day or ceases operating.

example.english: The shop will shut at nine tonight.
example.jyutping: gaan1 pou3 tau4 gam1 maan5 gau2 dim2 gwaan1 mun4

rows.note: Use this when someone or something is confined or trapped inside an enclosed place.

example.english: We were shut in by the gate and couldn't get out.
example.traditional: 我哋畀道閘困住咗，出唔到去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 bei2 dou6 zaap6 kwan3 zyu6 zo2 ceot1 m4 dou2 heoi3

rows.note: Use this for a business or venue that is not open to customers, such as on a particular day.

example.english: This shop is shut on Sundays.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 sing1 kei4 jat6 m4 hoi1

rows.note: Use this when a service, device, or facility is unavailable for use or is not functioning.

example.english: The lift is shut because it is broken.
example.jyutping: bou6 sing1 gong3 gei1 waai6 zo2 m4 jung6 dak1

rows.note: Use this for a person or mind that is unreceptive to new ideas.

example.english: They are very shut off and will not listen to new ideas.
example.traditional: 佢個人好封閉，唔肯聽新諗法。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 fung1 bai3 m4 hang2 teng1 san1 nam2 faat3

rows.note: Use this when someone deliberately becomes unreceptive or closed off to people or ideas.

example.english: After the breakup, they shut themselves off and wouldn't talk to anyone.
example.traditional: 佢失戀之後成日封閉自己，唔肯同人傾偈。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6 seng4 jat6 fung1 bai3 zi6 gei2 m4 hang2 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2
